verdict.rationale: Orb documents an Ingest Usage Events endpoint, throughput of 1M+ billing events per second, per-event idempotency that prevents duplicates within the account grace period, and backdating through late-data handling with automatic invoice recalculation plus historical event backfills. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the throughput and idempotency claims, and documented limits on how far back late events can be backdated.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream high-volume usage events — API calls, tokens, compute-seconds — into a metering pipeline with idempotent ingestion and backdating support

citations.quote: Use the Ingest Usage Events endpoint to send usage events into Orb.
Handle 1M+ billing events per second in production deployments.
Orb provides per-event idempotency through the API to guarantee that duplicates are never processed within the account grace period.
Late data handled safely. Orb recalculates affected invoices automatically.
Orb is fundamentally architected to support event backfills, which makes it easy to replay historical usage
